title: Python programming
subject: python
content: Python is a high-level programming language known for its simple syntax and readability. It supports variables, loops, functions, lists, and dictionaries. Python is widely used in web development, automation, data science, and artificial intelligence.

title: INTRODUCTION OF DATA STRUCTURE
subject: DSA
content:
Data structures are ways of organizing and storing data efficiently. Common structures include arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees and graphs
Choosing the right data structure helps improve program performance
